semiconductor_relevance: High — Genius Co., Ltd. provides critical vacuum components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Genius Co., Ltd. is a South Korean company specializing in precision vacuum equipment and components for the semiconductor and display industries. They manufacture high-quality throttle valves, vacuum valves, and pressure controllers, focusing on precise pressure control and rapid response characteristics. Their products are designed to replace costly imported components, enhancing efficiency and reliability in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: APC Valve for high precision and repeatability

regional_presence.Korea: Genius Co., Ltd. is based in South Korea and leverages domestic technology to manufacture its products.
